questions.stem: What is the cause of Type 1 diabetes?

options.text: The body's cells become resistant to insulin
The pancreas does not produce enough insulin because the immune system destroys beta cells
Too much sugar in the diet damages the pancreas
The liver produces too much glycogen

questions.explanation: Type 1 diabetes is an autoimmune condition where the immune system attacks and destroys the beta cells in the pancreas, so little or no insulin is produced.
